title: What is qteasy
summary: qteasy is a local quantitative-research toolkit: data, strategies, backtest, optimization, and simulated live trading share one pipeline.
narrative:
qteasy is a Python toolkit for quantitative research and trading-strategy development. It covers the path from market data to strategies, backtest, parameter optimization, and simulated live trading.

Four properties define it. The pipeline is local: data, research, and runs stay on your machine. The same strategy logic is used for backtest and simulated live, and the engine injects only the data visible at that step. Strategies can be combined, and many built-in strategies are ready to run.

qteasy includes an AI agent. Ask explains concepts. Plan shows a reviewable list of steps. High-side-effect work waits until you confirm. An MCP connection under the display name qteasy is planned and is not released; this card does not give connection steps.

How the parts fit together, and why this is easier than a hand-written backtest, are separate questions.
risk_notes: Ask never downloads data or runs a backtest. Use Plan, then confirm, before high-side-effect work. This is not investment advice.
